#0 view — the sight-line triangle walks from beside the world-disc toward the ring's edge, inside the held image's frame (the situated line of sight acquiring its position); gentle attract field; a slow turbulence LFO breathes the world before the view (auto-drift). #1 confidence — grid layout (Gebser's sector claiming exclusive validity); the enclosure square grows; the unmarked remainder is pushed to the frame's edge and marked x — the measure's own act of counting what escapes it as deficient; the absent Father (∅) stands inside the enclosure; field turns inward (circulation −0.4); pointer repel/shove — the view discounts the witness.

#2 Dionysus — the bounded disc dismembers (❋) and reconstitutes as a ring: what dies is the form's claim to stand complete; what returns must acquire a form; field turbulence 0.4, dispersion 0.2, vortex pointer — the maenadic opening; ϴ (the opened circle) brightens at the rim.

#3 Daphne — Daphne carries a repel field (the other who cannot be absorbed); her own boundary-ring deepens green and tightens around her under both powers' pull (A and ϴ hold attract at the edges — drawn, not merging); pointer repel/pulse — respect of the other's edge; no Ovidian pursuit is staged (her separate whole is declared, not restaged).

#4 diaphaneity — THE 3D SCENE. z is the opening of 180° into 360°: the perspectival triangle stays deep (z −0.35), the contextual ring expands at z 0, the ∴ of counter-positions stands nearest (z +0.3), care ❤ and the knower's ◉ hold intermediate depths — the knower has a position within the field, not above it; depth perspective + occlusion with a cold depth tint; contextual ring sequence 180°-small → 360°-full; circulation LFO breathes the field (auto-context); pointer attract/implode — the context gathers without erasing.

#5→0 return — the definite image offered again: a triangle (e147) stands inside the relation ring beside the renewed seeing ◉, A20/A21 and the ↺ of contextual return — the record's own return, 'Apollo returns to articulation. A definite image can again be offered to another'; attract strength halved against #0 (0.35 vs 0.7) — offering without grasping. ENDING QUALIFIES BEGINNING: #0's sight-line walked inside the gold ring toward its edge (a view forming); #5→0 sets the triangle at rest within the same ring — the act of seeing re-formed inside the relation it had only begun to hold, Daphne's green ◉ remnant at the rim; the field that opened gathering (attract 0.7) closes offering (attract 0.35).

Human-amplified staging (frontmatter: all three relations yes): the alterity check, mutual answerability and contextual return are Taylor's authored programme — the scene bodies carry the landings (A20, Mv 35, Draft 3) and the record-scope guards (no Ovidian restaging; Dionysus not in Ovid's cast). Mythemic verbs only: Daphne proves-discloses the alterity difference; no formal entailment, no historical attribution.

Automation: auto-drift (turbulence, the world before the view) and auto-context (circulation, the contextual field's breath) — tied to the record's moves. glyph_rationales.something stands out — figure against gr: the triangle: a difference made distinct, definite enough to revisit, question and change (#0).
glyph_rationales.the seer — the one the view belongs to: the person for whom the view matters: body, history, language and concern affect what becomes salient (#0).

glyph_rationales.the kantharos — shared life, held and po: the wine cup: participation — the living relation the self-sufficient view concealed (#2).
glyph_rationales.the bounded form — what dies is the clai: the drawn figure closing, scattered, and returning open-armed: dismemberment and reconstitution — what dies is the form's claim, what returns must carry living relation (#2).

glyph_rationales.the music beneath the words: the note beside the opened enclosure: Dionysian wisdom mediated through the drama (#2).

glyph_rationales.the other centre — existence exceeding w: the triangle apart from both figures: Daphne's office — neither a balance of quantities nor an intermediate blend (#3).
glyph_rationales.the emblem — the image continuing after: the wreath ring: appropriation after withdrawal — the failure of possession at one level need not end its symbolic continuation (#3).
glyph_rationales.the pursuit — the line that arrives at t: the arrow: Apollo cannot make illumination into entitlement; Dionysus cannot make participation into permission to absorb (#3).
glyph_rationales.the rays — the view opened to every aspe: radiants in all directions: aperspectivity — perspective released from exclusive validity, not amalgamated away (#4).
glyph_rationales.the contextual field — limits, relations: the wide ring: positions, counter-positions and the conditions of their transition made available together (#4).
glyph_rationales.the Rotundum — the round that cannot pro: nested circles: the ultimate context, impartial because it proceeds from no limited perspective (#4).
glyph_rationales.contextual inclusion: the notation on the stage's edge: the authorial operation by which the knower's position joins the accounted relations (#4).
glyph_rationales.depth through circumstance: the native mark in gold: this view appears through a source and capacity it cannot exhaust (#4).
glyph_rationales.the lyre — articulation returned, speaki: the lyre drawn: Apollo returns to articulation — a definite image again offered, now bearing its acknowledged relation (#5→0).
glyph_rationales.the leaf — the answer still alive in the: the single leaf: Daphne effective within participation — another centre can answer without being pre-assigned the answer (#5→0).
